parameters.jsCode: const context=$('Claim workbook').first().json;const studio=context.config,plan=context.plan,group=context.source;const file=$input.first().json;if(file.id!==studio.masterSpreadsheetId||file.mimeType!=='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'||file.capabilities?.canCopy!==true||!file.owners?.some(o=>o.emailAddress===studio.googleAccountEmail))throw Error('Master ownership/copy permission mismatch');return [{json:{verified:true}}];
